side_by_side.official_intent: Developer Comments: The cooldown of Particle Barrier is being increased to reduce Zarya's personal barrier uptime and energy generation. Projected Barrier remains unchanged, encouraging more proactive use on allies.
side_by_side.reviewer_inferred_intent: 该改动只提高了粒子屏障的冷却时间，意图是降低该技能的使用频率，从而削弱其覆盖/保护节奏。没有其他数值联动，说明这是一次单点、定向的削弱，而非整体重做。
reviewer_cannot_determine: 该削弱是否被其他未展示的改动对冲
